author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Dartmouth Health Children’s has received a $30 million gift from entrepreneur and philanthropist Tom Golisano, the largest philanthropic contribution in Dartmouth Health’s history. The Children’s Hospital at Dartmouth will be renamed Golisano Children’s Hospital at Dartmouth Health in perpetuity, linking the Lebanon-based hospital to a national alliance of pediatric institutions supported by Golisano.

Dartmouth Health said the funding will strengthen the pediatric workforce, modernize facilities and expand access to care in southern New Hampshire. Planned work includes renovations to the intensive care nursery and pediatric critical-care areas. The gift also is expected to help the system recruit and retain specialists while bringing more services closer to families who now travel farther north for appointments.

The hospital serves as New Hampshire’s only full-service children’s hospital and provides specialty care across the region. Joining the Golisano Children’s Alliance gives its clinicians another channel for sharing practices and collaborating with other pediatric centers. Dartmouth Health said the investment is intended to improve both the physical care environment and the long-term capacity of programs serving children and families throughout northern New England.
dek: Tom Golisano’s donation, the largest in Dartmouth Health history, will support pediatric staffing, renovations and expanded southern New Hampshire care.
headline: $30 million gift will rename and expand New Hampshire’s children’s hospital
